startUrls.title: URLs to check
startUrls.description: Listing pages to check on every run. Each URL keeps its own baseline between runs.

selectors.title: Fields and selectors
selectors.description: Selector generations, tried in order. Each is {"name", "row", "key", "value"}: `row` is a regular expression whose first group is one row, `key` and `value` are regular expressions whose first group is the field inside that row. `key` identifies the item between runs, `value` is the field watched for changes. Keep old generations listed: a page that only the old or only the new one matches is how SCHEMA_DRIFT is detected. Leave empty to use the built-in demo selectors.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: At most this many URLs are checked (and charged) per run. Extra URLs are skipped and logged.

requestIntervalMillis.title: Request interval
requestIntervalMillis.description: Minimum time between two requests to the same domain, robots.txt and retries included.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout. Timed-out requests are retried with exponential backoff.

userAgent.title: User agent
userAgent.description: Sent with every request and used to match robots.txt rules. Identify yourself honestly.
